note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 by an independent auditor: the handler_test units changed only by identifier renames to internal/core/tftp (opX->tftp.OpX, errX->tftp.CodeX, defaultBlockSize->tftp.DefaultBlockSize), constant values identical, assertions unchanged. The operative MUST is the sender waiting for the ACK: TestRFC1350LockstepWaitsForTheACK requires block 1 to be octets 0..511, silence for 1 s with block 1 unacked, then block 2 = octets 512..1023 after ACK 1. The receiver's duty to ACK every DATA is RFC1350-2-3's subject.
